verdicts.reason: Both break the design the same way. The text has been pulled out of the label frame, which is left empty apart from stray divider rules. The illustrations have shrunk to a tiny strip of icons, and the bottom third and the middle of the canvas are dead space. A squeezes 'J'adore Paris', LAVANDER and a tiny SKINCARE into one cramped header row. B makes LAVANDER bigger and slightly enlarges the illustrations, but leaves SKINCARE floating on its own, left-aligned and off the centred axis.
